# MaVik — Viktor Makarchuk — English Edition

> Native English edition of mavik.name: books, essays and music. Public content is available without authentication.

## Structural English routes
The remaining completed Ukrainian works already have stable /en/ routes. Those temporary preparation pages are intentionally noindex until the native English text replaces them.

## Language counterparts
English pages use /en/. Ukrainian originals use the same route without the /en prefix.
